title: Mixed Event — Carnation Recollection — Episode3 Condoling Rain

meta.Event Outline: Despite Kanade's persistent efforts to save Mafuyu, none of the songs she composes seem to leave an impression on her. Feeling like she's reached a dead end, Kanade heads to SEKAI for advice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But even if he is awake, which “dad” is he going to be...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Here's to hoping for a real conversation...)

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line:
You came at a good time.
Your father's awake.

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: However, it's difficult to say how much he can remember at the moment...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I'll try talking to him.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Good morning.
Or afternoon, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I'm not sure I got your name.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
I apologize for not remembering...
Apparently, stress from work caused my memory to become pretty jumbled.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Again, I'm so sorry. After you came all this way to visit. I can't seem to remember anything about my family either...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Yes.
We're actually about to become parents.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: My wife's in her second trimester and her belly's been growing so much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I know that I need to be by her side as much as possible, but look at me... How can I in this state...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know that you're a kind person who cares about his family very much, Mr. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Haha. Thank you.
Also, I didn't catch your name...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Kanade? What a coincidence.
We're thinking about calling our baby that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: My wife and I love music very much, so we're hoping that we'll be able to enjoy it together as a family...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Look at me. I'm just rambling on about myself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I hope you get better soon.
Especially for your family's sake...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Me too. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: He went back in time quite a ways today...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, he did...
But I'm glad that I got to see him doing so well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anyways, I've dropped off his change of clothes, so if you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I have no right to feel this sad...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm the one that did this to dad.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I don't have time to feel bad.
I have to keep composing.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I have to save Mafuyu. I have to save as many people as I can with my music.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Is that Kanade...?
Oh, maybe she's on her way home after visiting her dad.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I probably shouldn't butt in unannounced. Plus, we'll talk on Nightcord later, so I guess I don't need to go up to her now and...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hang on... What? She's not using an umbrella!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(She'll catch a cold if she doesn't...
She looks so sad too...
Could something have happened to her?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mizuki...?
What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm on my way home from work.
More importantly, why are you walking around in the rain without an umbrella? You'll get sick, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I was just thinking about something...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's really been pushing herself with that new song too. I can't just leave her like this...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have to finish that song...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It won't help Mafuyu at all at this rate. I have to keep working on it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry, I need to go home...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Hey, hold on one sec!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's a super cute cafe just around the corner here. Wanna check it out together, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It'll just be for a little bit!
A little break before you get back to that song!
